@servers.sheet.protocolSmb.sameAsSourceJustification: Protocol name, kept verbatim in pt-BR as everywhere else in the catalog (style.md § Brand and do-not-translate lists SMB; enforced by desktop-i18n-dont-translate). macOS pt-BR ships it untranslated too (Finder pt_BR.lproj/ConnectToWindow.strings offers smb:// unchanged).

@servers.sheet.protocolSftp.sameAsSourceJustification: Protocol name, kept verbatim in pt-BR: macOS pt-BR never translates it (Finder pt_BR.lproj/ConnectToWindow.strings keeps the ftp/sftp scheme as-is, macOS 26.6.2 build 25G83, 2026-09-06), and the catalog already publishes SFTP unchanged in settings.appearance.tintSmb.description.

@servers.sheet.protocolWebdav.sameAsSourceJustification: Protocol name, kept verbatim in pt-BR: the sibling servers.refusal.notAWebdavServer already ships “Nenhum serviço WebDAV responde neste endereço.” with the acronym untouched, and macOS pt-BR keeps WebDAV as-is.

@servers.sheet.addressPlaceholder.sameAsSourceJustification: An example hostname, not prose: `nas.local` is a literal mDNS name and stays identical in every locale. The `.local` suffix belongs to the protocol, and `nas` is the same three letters the catalog already publishes as the NAS acronym (settings.network.smbConcurrency.description).
